name: Kingstown House

tagline.en: A long-established family B&B in the middle of Clifden town, with a warm welcome and the best local tips.
tagline.ga: B&B teaghlaigh le fada an lá i lár bhaile an Chlocháin, le fáilte chroíúil agus na moltaí áitiúla is fearr.

en: Kingstown House is a long-established, family-run B&B right in Clifden town centre, approved by Fáilte Ireland.
Guests love the welcome and the local tips: where to eat, which beach to try and when to drive the Sky Road. Everything in Clifden is a short stroll from the door.
ga: Is B&B é Kingstown House atá á reáchtáil ag teaghlach le fada an lá, díreach i lár bhaile an Chlocháin, faofa ag Fáilte Ireland.
Is breá le haíonna an fháilte agus na moltaí áitiúla: cá háit le hithe, cén trá le triail agus cathain le Bóthar na Spéire a thiomáint. Tá gach rud sa Chlochán siúlóid ghearr ón doras.

highlights.ga: Á reáchtáil ag teaghlach le blianta

desc.en: A comfortable double room with its own bathroom.
desc.ga: Seomra dúbailte compordach lena sheomra folctha féin.

desc.en: Two single beds, ideal for friends or walkers.
desc.ga: Dhá leaba shingile, iontach do chairde nó do shiúlóirí.

policies.en: Book direct with us: no booking fees.
policies.ga: Cuir in áirithe go díreach linn: gan táillí áirithinte.

a.en: You deal with us, not a booking site: no booking fees, and we can answer any question before you book.
a.ga: Déileálann tú linn féin, ní le suíomh áirithinte: gan táillí áirithinte, agus is féidir linn ceist ar bith a fhreagairt sula gcuireann tú in áirithe.

perks.en: Best price when you book direct

perks.en: Book by phone, straight to us
perks.ga: Cuir in áirithe ar an bhfón, go díreach linn

perks.en: Ask us anything before you book
perks.ga: Cuir ceist ar bith orainn roimh ré
